meta.tprFormula: temporal PageRank: recency-biased teleport + age-decayed citation weights. Directed edges citing → cited. Edge weight w=1/(1+max(0,y_citing−y_cited)). Teleport π_i ∝ exp(α(y_i−y_min)) with α=ln(10)/(y_max−y_min)=0.0562 (newest ~10× oldest). Damping d=0.85. Missing years filled with median 2021.
meta.kCoreDef: Undirected k-core on the intra-corpus citation graph: a cite is an undirected edge between citing and cited catalog works. Core number = largest k such that the paper remains in the subgraph where every node has degree ≥ k. In-core (kin) peels by in-degree on citing→cited. Decade core is undirected k-core inside each decade induced subgraph, then unioned.
meta.citesDef: citation_count_work (max across versions; OpenAlex/S2 work-level Cites), independent of In.
meta.inOutDef: In = # of other 1806 papers that cite this work. Out = # of this work’s refs that are in the 1806. Induced on the catalog subgraph.
meta.cohortDef: Year-cohort percentile: rank global cites within publication-year bins merged until ≥8 papers (sparse years share a bin).
